caption: The video showcases a fixed high-angle view of a vintage Bally 'Chicago' pinball playfield, its cream-and-yellow artwork framed by red '10' standup targets, a central 'CHICAGO' band, top rollover lanes, and two resting flippers at the bottom. A single chrome ball is the only moving element. After a brief static interval, the ball appears on the upper right side of the playfield and moves upward and leftward along a curved right-hand lane toward the upper-right area. There it reaches its highest point before reversing direction and descending along the right edge. The ball continues downward and rightward along the outer right lane, remaining to the right of the right '10' target and still traveling at the end. Throughout this motion the playfield layout, target graphics, and flipper positions remain unchanged.
